title: Allow agents to select semantic Configuration and Platform
outcome: Allow agents to select semantic Configuration and Platform
acceptance: An agent can explicitly select Configuration and Platform for semantic analysis, including Release, x86, x64 and custom project-defined values; omission uses the documented Debug and AnyCPU defaults.
Regression tests distinguish Debug versus Release and AnyCPU versus x86/x64, preserve the existing target-framework selection, and cover explicit custom values.
Responses expose the effective context; evaluator inputs, captured dependencies and semantic cache identities remain consistent with that context, without cross-context leakage.
